```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Before SVG.</p><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"><script>alert('svg-xss')</script><text>SVG text</text></svg><p>After SVG.</p>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result.content)
}
```
